summary: LSU heads to Ole Miss with Leavitt questionable after Thursday’s availability update. Whoever takes the snaps, protecting the ball and sustaining drives will matter alongside disciplined defensive pressure.

items.headline: Leavitt was upgraded to questionable on Thursday
items.tldr: The upgrade does not confirm he will play at Ole Miss. Follow the final availability report, then watch ball security whoever takes the snaps.

items.headline: Umanmielen recorded three sacks against Louisiana Tech
items.tldr: Watch whether the defensive front can disrupt the pocket while keeping its lanes. A free scramble can undo otherwise effective pressure.

items.headline: Chambliss completed 23 of 26 passes against Charlotte
items.tldr: Watch the underneath coverage as closely as the pass rush. Making the quarterback hold the ball would give pressure time to arrive.

items.headline: Construction changes the route around The Grove
items.tldr: Check the revised pickup and dropoff directions before driving into Oxford. Plan the approach to campus as well as the parking spot.

items.headline: Kiffin wants LSU focused on preparation for his Oxford return
items.tldr: Watch the communication before the snap and the response after a bad play. Keeping attention on the next assignment is the useful test of that message.

lead.headline: Check the quarterback, then the decisions.
lead.body: Leavitt’s Thursday status is questionable. Whoever plays, watch the response when the first scoring option disappears: a safe exit can preserve the possession.

matchup.question: What matters most at Ole Miss?
matchup.answer: Protect the ball near the goal line, make the opposing quarterback work past his first read, and keep defensive pressure under control.
